notablePrerequisites:
Your devotion to green is at least two.
Your combined devotion to blue and green is at least twelve.
description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to your devotion to that color.
Activate Gretchen by tapping {2}{G}{U}, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat, alternating the color of mana added by Nyx Lotus.
